question: What authoritative designation is given to this eight-cornered fire pit?
premises: A fire pit with eight corners is being described.
Knowers of the tantras make authoritative declarations.
This pit is declared by such knowers.
inference: Therefore, this eight-cornered pit is the form declared by those who know the tantras.
plain_english: This eight-cornered fire pit is indeed declared by those who know the tantras.
